title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 11
paragraphs: Meanwhile Darius, as soon as he had crossed the Hellespont and come to Sardis, remembered the service rendered to him by Histiaeus of Miletus and also the advice of Coës of Mytilene. Sending for them to come to Sardis, he offered them a choice of rewards. Histiaeus, being already tyrant of Miletus, did not ask for any additional government, but requested the district of Myrcinus belonging to the Edonians, wishing to found a city there. So Histiaeus chose this for himself; but Coës, not being a tyrant but a private citizen, asked to be made tyrant of Mytilene.
